crm_notes: Account profile: mid-market SaaS focused on product analytics and commerce search. Heavy personalization; stores hashed PII in user profiles. Data residency: US only for primary; EMEA subset in EU region.

Use-case detail: replace current vector-search + custom reranker. Primary goal: 50–100ms p99 for assistant; 30ms average for embeddings lookups. Throughput expectation: bursts to ~500 req/s for search endpoints, sustained 50 rps for assistant.

Security posture: mature security team (2 full-time infra/security engineers). Require SOC2 Type II report, SSO via SAML (Okta), KMS integration for key rotation, per-token audit logs with 2y retention (prefer 7y for compliance team).

Quotes from call: 'We need predictable SLA and a clear path to isolate traffic — happy to start on Hosted for evaluation but Dedicated (VPC) is a must for production timelines' - Head of Platform (Maya R.)
Commercial notes: procurement needs a firm estimate for 12-month reserved capacity. Current ask: committed 4 GPU nodes with burst to managed pool. Desire price break once >=$150k ARR committed.
Technical concerns: model fallbacks required; team wants auto-fallback to smaller quantized model for cost-control during spikes. Ask: routing policies + automatic fallback docs and sample configs.
Action items captured: provide SOC2 package, provide SSO integration guide + test IdP metadata, produce Dedicated POC SOW and preliminary cost model, schedule security workshop.
